explanation.headline: No public FDA signal at our plants; Corvale East has 4 days on hand and Corvale Lakeside has 26 days on hand

sentences.text: Corvale East holds 31 units at 8.5 per day, giving 4 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 30 units at 1.2 per day, giving 26 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 128 units at 8.9 per day, giving 14 days on hand.
Both Corvale East and Corvale Lakeside use the same B. Braun product (NDC 00264193310) manufactured by B. Braun Medical Inc.
Corvale General also uses a Baxter product (NDC 00338049906) in addition to the B. Braun product.

rejected.text: FDA's public shortage database shows no signal for the amino acid injection products used at Corvale facilities.
Transferring 13 units from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East would leave Lakeside with 17 units (14 days) and raise East to 44 units (5 days).

Q-a30fcc.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%valine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%valine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-ebfe81.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('cb6d23ff-3ec5-445a-acbe-f88fd57949bf') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-5614d7.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%isoleucine,%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-80b001.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%isoleucine,%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-c98df6.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%isoleucine,%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%solution%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-586933.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1416980', '2618677') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-c2b930.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1416980', '2618677') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-b1afb5.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('b braun')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-55bbd9.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('b braun', 'b braun medical', 'baxter') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%isoleucine,%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-c7ce36.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00264193310', '00338049906')

Q-030b23.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%isoleucine,%'
